ORIENTATION DAY 2024
Overview
Kakatiya University
warmly welcomes its new students with a well-structured Orientation Day Program, designed to introduce them to the university’s academic environment, facilities, and culture. This event serves as a guiding platform for freshers, helping them transition smoothly into university life.
The program includes welcome addresses by faculty and senior administrators, providing insights into the university’s vision, mission, and academic opportunities. Interactive sessions cover key aspects such as curriculum structure, student support services, library resources, and extracurricular activities. Special sessions on career guidance, research opportunities, and campus life ensure that students gain a comprehensive understanding of their journey ahead.
With a strong focus on student engagement and motivation,
Kakatiya University’s
Orientation Day Program sets the stage for a fulfilling and enriching academic experience, empowering students to excel in their chosen fields.
